summary: This note describes Doha, the capital and most populous city of Qatar, located on the Persian Gulf coast in the east of the country. It gives the city's population figures, notes its status as Qatar's fastest growing city and economic center, and gives the meaning of its Arabic name.
one_line: Doha is the capital and most populous city of Qatar, on the Persian Gulf coast, and its economic center.
key_facts: Doha is the capital city and most populous city of the State of Qatar.
Doha has a population of 1,351,000 in a city proper.
The population of Doha is close to 1.5 million when considered with its surrounding area.
Doha is located on the coast of the Persian Gulf in the east of Qatar.
Doha is Qatar's fastest growing city.
Over 50% of the nation's population lives in Doha or its surrounding suburbs.
Doha is the economic center of Qatar.
The Arabic name الدوحة is transliterated as ad-Dawḥa or ad-Dōḥa.
The name Doha literally means 'the big tree' in Modern Standard Arabic.
Locally, the name Doha is understood to mean 'rounded bays'.
